reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Investing in prevention, diagnosis and treatment of HIV and TB towards achieving 90-90-90 targets in Zanzibar - Zanzibar (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Zanzibar, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar (Ministry of Health, Zanzibar)This program has the following goals: To prevent the spread of HIV infection among Zanzibaris, provide quality continuum of care to all PLHIV, and mitigate the accompanying negative psycho-social outcomes. To reduce the incidenceby 25% and mortality by 50% of TB and leprosy by 2020. The objectives of this program are: 50% of Key Populations in Zanzibar embrace risk reduction including the correct and consistent use of condoms by ending of 2020. 70 % of public and private health facilities providing comprehensive quality STIs diagnosis and treatment services by 2020. 95% of pregnant women accessing quality hospital based PMTCT services by 2020. 90% of PLHIV receive appropriate care and treatment by 2020. HIV related Strategic Information available for use by policy makers, programme planners and implementers at all levels of the national response. To improve universal access to quality assured services for diagnosis and treatment for all forms of TB and leprosy including children. To diagnose and enroll all estimated MDR TB cases by 2020. To increase propotion of TB patient co infected with HIV receiving timely ART from 52 to 100 by 2020
